newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR NOVEMBER 1-4.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR NOVEMBER 1-4.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer
fixtures for November 1 to 4:
Friday, November 1:
Scottish premier division - Kilmarnock v Hibernian.
Saturday, November 2:
English premier league - Aston Villa v Nottingham Forest,
Derby v Leicester, Leeds v Sunderland, Manchester United v
Chelsea, Sheffield Wednesday v Southampton, Tottenham v West
Ham, Wimbledon v Arsenal.
English division one - Bolton v Huddersfield, Bradford v
Oldham, Norwich v Charlton, Oxford v Ipswich, Port Vale v
Birmingham, Portsmouth v West Bromwich, Queens Park Rangers v
Stoke, Southend v Reading, Swindon v Manchester City, Tranmere v
Crystal Palace, Wolverhampton v Barnsley.
English division two - Bournemouth v Bury, Bristol Rovers v
Gillingham, Crewe v Wycombe, Millwall v Walsall, Notts County v
Shrewsbury, Peterborough v Blackpool, Plymouth v Luton, Preston
v Rotherham, Stockport v Bristol City, Watford v Brentford,
Wrexham v Chesterfield, York v Burnley.
English division three - Carlisle v Wigan, Colchester v
Cardiff, Darlington v Scarborough, Doncaster v Chester, Fulham v
Lincoln, Hartlepool v Brighton, Hereford v Barnet, Hull v
Cambridge, Leyton Orient v Torquay, Mansfield v Scunthorpe,
Rochdale v Exeter, Swansea v Northampton.
Scottish premier division - Celtic v Aberdeen, Hearts v
Dunfermline, Motherwell v Dundee United, Raith v Rangers.
Scottish division one - Clydebank v Falkirk, Dundee v St
Mirren, Greenock Morton v Airdrieonians, Stirling v Partick.
Postponed: St Johnstone v East Fife.
Scottish division two - Berwick v Hamilton, Clyde v Ayr,
Livingston v Dumbarton, Stenhousemuir v Queen of the South.
Postponed: Stranraer v Brechin.
English division three - Albion v Arbroath, Cowdenbeath v
Alloa, East Stirling v Inverness, Montrose v Queen's Park, Ross
County v Forfar.
Sunday, November 3:
English premier league - Blackburn v Liverpool, Newcastle v
Middlesbrough.
English division one - Grimsby v Sheffield United.
Scottish Challenge Cup final - Stranraer v St Johnstone.
Monday, November 4:
English premier league - Everton v Coventry.
